test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : + and ÷ 

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 + 11 ÷ 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

⇒ 44 + __**11 ÷ 7**__ × 3 - 19 = 2

⇒ 44 + __**1.57 × 3**__ - 19 = 2

⇒ __**44 + 4.71**__ - 19 = 2

⇒ __**48.71 - 19**__ = 2

⇒ 29.71 ≠ 2

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : - and +

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 ÷ 11 - 7 × 3 + 19 = 2

⇒ __**44 ÷ 11**__ - 7 × 3 + 19 = 2

⇒ 4 - __**7 × 3**__ + 19 = 2

⇒__** **____**4 **__- 21 __**+ 19 **__= 2

⇒ __**23**____** - 21**__ = 2

**⇒ 2 = 2**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 3) : = and ÷ 

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 = 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 ÷ 2

⇒ 44 = 11 + 7 × 3 - __**19 ÷ 2**__

⇒ 44 = 11 + __**7 × 3**__ - 9.5

⇒ 44 = __**11 + 21**__ - 9.5

⇒ 44 = __**32 - 9.5**__

⇒ 44 ≠ 22.5

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : - and =

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 = 19 - 2

⇒ __**44 ÷ 11**__ + 7 × 3 = 19 - 2

⇒ 4 + __**7 × 3**__ = 19 - 2

⇒ __**4 + 21**__ = __**19 - 2**__

⇒ 25 ≠ 17

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"- and +".**
